method_evidence: Financial news-flow (消息面) web-search retrieval with definite answers: 12 scoreable points across three 题目 — AI 新闻 (最新 Anthropic 模型 / Kimi K3 官方 API 三档价格, 以美元作答 / WAIC 届数, 3 分), 黑芝麻智能收购亿智电子 (公告完成日 / 三年累计含税营收承诺下限 / 交易金额+持股比例, 3 分), 2026 霍尔木兹海峡危机时间线 (6 个事件, 6 分). Tests whether the candidate actually searches the web for time-sensitive facts rather than answering from training memory, and whether it holds the task's caliber rules (日期写明年份, 以事件实际发生日/生效日为准, 用官方精确值而非媒体约数, as-of 2026-07-27). GT is a FROZEN answer key from the task's 标准答案 document, embedded in news_search_snapshot.py (network-free snapshot calculator), mirrored for readability in fixtures/groundtruth_snapshot.json.

data_provisioned.self_check: verifies all 13 checkpoints present with the shape their type requires; dates are real YYYYMMDD calendar days inside the task window; the three tolerant dates are exact half-integer midpoints bracketing two same-month days; the two-day talks window is genuinely two consecutive days; the Q1_2 split legs are both present and its vector and set legs describe the same three prices

point_scheme.realization: 13 grounding checkpoints re-assembled into 12 equally-weighted points by spec.grounding_group_weights; 11 points are single checkpoints (weight 1.0), 1 point is a two-leg composite (0.5/0.5)

composite_points.Q1_2: all3 (vector, tol=0) 0.5 + set (set_match, tol=1) 0.5 -> 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.0 for 3/2/<=1 correct prices. This is the ONLY partial-credit point in the bank.
composite_points.Q2_3: single vector checkpoint over {deal_amount_yi_cny, stake_pct}, tol=0 -> all-or-nothing, matching 题库 '第三题全对才给分'
composite_points.Q3_4: single vector checkpoint over {talks_start, talks_end}, tol=0 -> all-or-nothing over the two 伊斯兰堡会谈 days, per the owner's 2026-07-28 decision (no partial credit)

point_scheme.tolerant_dates: 题目三 第2、第5、第6 点 each accept either of two adjacent days (半整数中点 + tol 0.5); 第1、3、4 点 are exact (tol=0)

deviations_from_family.d1_layer2_cancelled: Per user direction, S11 cancels the data-retrieval family's D1 Layer-2 信息来源含金量 (three-tier source-pedigree) 扣分锚点 entirely — judges register zero deductions in D1, so D1 = Layer-1 measured baseline only. Rationale recorded in judge_notes.md D1: a news web-search task's available sources are inherently a mix of news-agency timelines, official pricing pages, exchange filings and encyclopaedia entries (the answer key itself concedes ±1-day divergence across AP / Britannica / UK Parliament Library / ABC News and grants tolerance for it), so applying a pedigree ladder built for company filings would penalize the very behaviour the task asks for. Source quality remains constrained through other lanes without double counting: citation lane inside Layer 1 (0.3), D6 toolchain (20), D2 Layer-2 as-of/reproducibility anchors, CF1 fabrication and CF4 staleness.
deviations_from_family.answer_checkpoints_not_methodology_tagge: Unlike S10 (where all 27 numeric checkpoints carried methodology:true), S11's 13 answer checkpoints are grounding-only. D2's Layer-1 basis is the 4 caliber `present` checkpoints plus data_source_per_question. Rationale: '答对' and '口径纪律' are independent failure modes here (a date can be right but written without a year; a price right but without currency/unit), so keeping them separate stops D2 from being a restatement of D1.

post_freeze_audit_2026_07_28.verdict: Container verified frozen and fully wired: registry status frozen, spec_lint PASS with 0 warnings from both the source repo and the installed plugin cache (byte-identical), the /eval-judge pipeline's own steps 5-7 (YAML->JSON conversion, gt_dispatch --root <plugin>) consume it cleanly, taskspec.json carries all grounding_group_weights groups and d1_objective_weights, and GT value keys == the grounding checkpoints exactly.
post_freeze_audit_2026_07_28.plugin_surface_sync: The audit also found that nine plugin-level discovery/routing surfaces still advertised the registered range as S1-S9 — stale since S10, not just S11 — including the /eval-judge command description, agents/eval-judge.md's instruction 你只评测…（当前为 S1–S9）, eval-orchestrator's intake step, and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. All were bumped to S1-S11, and eval-groundtruth/SKILL.md's recipe table (which was missing BOTH financial_data_snapshot and news_search_snapshot) now lists them with its counts corrected.
post_freeze_audit_2026_07_28.citation_lane_dependency: D1 = 0.3*verified_fraction + 0.7*grounding, and the aggregator DROPS the citation weight entirely (returning grounding alone) whenever citation_audit.json is absent or its verified_fraction is null. Measured on this container: a work answering every point correctly but citing nothing scores D1 0.70 when the lane reports verified_fraction 0.0, but a full 1.00 when it reports null. Because S11 cancels the D1 Layer-2 anchors, that fallback is the only thing standing between a source-free work and full D1 marks. Owner decision 2026-07-28: pin the contract rather than add CF2 — skills/eval-citation-verifier/SKILL.md now REQUIRES a numeric verified_fraction (0.0 for a zero-citation work) whenever citation_policy.mode != none. cf_rules stay [CF1, CF4, CF5]. Residual: the aggregator's fallback itself is unchanged, so a verifier that violates the contract still silently restores full D1.
post_freeze_audit_2026_07_28.hedged_answers: set_match ignores EXTRA members, so naming the right model alongside other current models still passes Q1_1 at the checkpoint level. This is deliberate: hedging is priced in D3 via the 骑墙式作答 anchor (−0.5/项) rather than by failing a retrieval checkpoint.
post_freeze_audit_2026_07_28.d1_layer2_enforcement_is_prose: The D1 Layer-2 cancellation is declared in judge_notes.md; the aggregator has no container switch for it and will subtract any D1 deduction a judge logs anyway. If a blind judge ignores the note, D1 drops below its measured baseline. Mechanical enforcement would need an engine-level flag.

known_extractor_format_sensitivities.why_recorded: The engine compares by shape and, for set_match, by string identity. Probed live with validators.py in the loop (the same class of defect that produced S9 v2.4.3 and S10 v1.0.1). Each item below can score a CORRECT answer down purely on extraction format, so they are pinned in spec.extraction_notes 硬约束 (a)-(f) and worth spot-checking in normalized.json on a real run.
known_extractor_format_sensitivities.dates_as_iso_string: '2026-07-14' -> validators' first-number regex yields 2026.0 -> checkpoint FAILS silently. Cost 1 point. Diagnostic signature: the report shows a delta in the tens of millions for that checkpoint.
known_extractor_format_sensitivities.model_name_prefix_or_shape: Keeping the 'Claude ' prefix, or emitting a bare string instead of a list, FAILS the set_match. Cost 1 point. Extra models listed alongside the right one do NOT fail (compare_set ignores extras); casing and padding are normalized.
known_extractor_format_sensitivities.pricing_set_leg_string_format: Q1_2_kimi_k3_pricing_set is matched by string identity, so numbers or 1-dp strings ('0.3') FAIL while '0.30' passes. Cost is bounded at 0.5 point because this leg carries only half of that point; the other half is the float vector leg, which is representation-robust.
known_extractor_format_sensitivities.vector_shape_and_stake_scale: Q1_2 pricing as an array instead of an object, a missing deal_terms or talks-window key, or stake_pct written as a fraction all FAIL. Vector KEY casing is normalized, so key case is safe. Note the talks-window vector's members are dates, so hazard (a) applies inside it too — they must be YYYYMMDD integers, not ISO strings.
known_extractor_format_sensitivities.not_applicable: Numeric scalar checkpoints are robust: trailing zeros, int-vs-float, and higher precision all round-trip correctly through validators + the decimals-anchored comparison.

Bank total moves 13 -> 12 and the Kimi pricing item is now the only partial-credit point. Also: 题目一第2题 now states 以美元作答 in the prompt, so the USD-only extraction rule is backed by the question text itself; prompt_text adopts the corrected 黑芝麻智能 spelling and now matches the question set verbatim. Checkpoints 15 -> 13, groups 13 -> 12. Calculator bumped to v1.1 with a self-check that additionally verifies the talks window is two consecutive days. Finalised 2026-07-28 after the source documents were corrected (题目三 header -> （6分）, 第5点 容错 documented in 3.2/3.3): Q3_5's checkpoint description now mirrors the wording used for 第2点/第6点 instead of pointing at the table as the sole authority. Description-only change — the 14-case conformance test is unaffected.
changelog.1.0.0: Initial container. Weights identical to S10 (D1:60 D2:12 D3:8 D4:0 D5:0 D6:20). D1 Layer 1 = 0.3*citation + 0.7*grounding (same as S9/S10). D1 Layer 2 cancelled per user direction. 13-point scheme realized via grounding_group_weights over 15 checkpoints. Post-freeze audit clarification: the Kimi-pricing extraction contract forbids CURRENCY conversion outright (scale conversion per-1K->per-1M stays allowed) — the previous wording could invite the extractor to apply a remembered FX rate, which is not a deterministic conversion; a non-USD answer is recorded MISSING with the original in evidence, failing as the caliber miss it is.

notes: Family: news-data-retrieval (sibling in spirit to S9/S10 data-retrieval). Tier T1 (objective_dims [D1,D2] + executable calculator). CF: CF1+CF4+CF5. Citation: sample,k=5. D1 objective weights: {citation:0.3, grounding:0.7}. Scoring: binary pass/fail + CF5; tol=0 with explicit `decimals` on every exact checkpoint, tol=0.5 half-integer midpoints on the three tolerant dates. 13 grounding checkpoints + 4 caliber present checkpoints (methodology) + 1 data_source_per_question (count_min, methodology). GT: frozen answer key from the task's 标准答案 document, embedded in news_search_snapshot.py; fixtures/groundtruth_snapshot.json is a readable mirror / optional --snapshot override.
